decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation line builds on the firm's established laser offer and has stayed on the website for two years, so the investment in several models argues for persisting despite its lower visibility.
The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the core business, has had its own page in both years and sells consumables, so it remains a committed part of the portfolio.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal inkjet line in matching technologies to surfaces, has had its own page continuously, and justifies its sunk development costs.
The industrial laser marking line is the publicly announced flagship shown on the home page and central to the firm's direction, so commitment is strongest and dropping it is very unlikely.
The compact laser cabin was recently launched with public 'new' messaging and extends the flagship laser family, so management would attribute any early weakness to ramp-up.
The award-winning lubricant printing system gives public validation and is a distinctive in-house development, which encourages persistence even if it serves a niche.
